answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 31089 Country: India Title: My question is one who has a debt is iy compulsory for him to do qurbani. Question: My question is one who has a debt is iy compulsory for him to do qurbani. Answer ID: 31089 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 484/484/M=1432) First, it is necessary to pay the debt. If that person remains sahib nisab (having amount payable for zakah) after paying the debt, then Qurbani is wajib in its days, otherwise not. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
